items.t: Supports same-day voter registration and automated voter registration, which became law in New Mexico when Senate Bill 672 was signed.
items.q: Same-day voter registration and automated voter registration have long been priorities of mine and it's a game-changer for New Mexico's voting and elections for them to now become law.

items.t: Says she has worked throughout her public career for fair and efficient elections and increased voter access.
items.q: Secretary of State Maggie Toulouse Oliver has spent her career as a public official working for greater transparency and ethics in government, fair and efficient elections, and increased voter access.

items.t: Is focused on increased transparency in financial disclosure and campaign finance reporting, and on advocating for stronger ethics legislation.
items.q: First elected in 2016, Secretary of State Toulouse Oliver is focused on providing increased transparency in financial disclosure and campaign finance reporting, modernizing the online campaign finance system, encouraging New Mexicans to get registered and vote, and advocating for good government and stronger ethics legislation.

record.t: Took office as New Mexico Secretary of State in 2016.
record.q: New Mexico Secretary of State Maggie Toulouse Oliver took office in 2016 with big ideas in mind.

record.t: Served as Bernalillo County Clerk from 2007 to 2016.
record.q: Secretary of State Toulouse Oliver previously served as Bernalillo County Clerk from 2007 to 2016.

record.t: Disqualified Republican Senate candidate Christopher Vanden Heuvel from the June primary ballot, ruling he did not submit enough qualified voter signatures.
record.q: Republican Christopher Vanden Heuvel was disqualified by New Mexico Secretary of State Maggie Toulouse Oliver, who ruled that the 2026 Senate candidate didn’t turn in enough qualified voter signatures to appear on the June primary ballot

record.t: Her office created a Native American Voting Task Force, which was established to improve election outcomes in New Mexico's tribal communities.
record.q: The Secretary of State’s Native American Voting Task Force was created with the express purpose of improving election outcomes in New Mexico’s tribal communities.
